description: Normalization and sampled playback controls for one song. All curves in both songs have a common sample count N >= 2. Sample i occurs at i * duration / (N - 1) elapsed seconds. Interpolate linearly in the supplied units. Apply all controls together; volume may exceed 1 and EQ may be positive.

gain.description: Linear normalization gain relative to decoded PCM, applied for the entire song. Replaces client ReplayGain or automatic normalization. Consistent for the song across adjacent plans in a playback session.

speed.description: Playback-rate multipliers; 1 is normal. Pitch follows speed without pitch-preserving time stretch.

volume.description: Linear fader multipliers on top of gain, including level compensation and peak control. Do not clamp to 1.

highDb.description: High-shelf gain in dB. Zero is flat; negative attenuates and positive boosts.

bassDb.description: Low-shelf gain in dB. Ignored for the incoming song when highpassHz is present.
